executive_summary: Today's OFAC sanctions list changes saw the removal of 9 individuals and updates to 39 existing entries, with no new additions. The removed individuals were all associated with the HK-EO13936 program, primarily located in Hong Kong and China. The updates involved changes to program associations, with many entities being moved from HK-EO13936 to HKAA.
